source: Q150 leave-one-out validation (same design as Q147/Q48): each of ct_vhm_forearm's real muscles held out, its own label reverted to open with itself as the only candidate, refined by scripts/transfer/refine_limb_transfer.py seeded by its own Q147 per-bone-transferred mesh, constrained to within 12mm of that seed inside the male's own vhm_forearm_muscles_cryo.nii.gz muscle-tissue label -- then compared to its TRUE voxel footprint. All 3 recovered.
shipped_as: xfer_zan2vhm_limb_refined (Q150), 9 male forearm structures actually shipped: brachioradialis_r, extensor_carpi_radialis_brevis_r, extensor_carpi_radialis_longus_r, extensor_carpi_ulnaris_r, extensor_pollicis_brevis_r, flexor_pollicis_longus_r, pronator_quadratus_r, pronator_teres_r, supinator_r (from radial_flexor_compartment / mobile_wad_compartment / extensor_digitorum_supinator_anconeus_compartment, plus a few individually-named-but-review-flagged labels once their own seed reached them). extensor_digitorum_r and extensor_indicis_r were attempted but their refined claim was too small (<0.15x Q147's own volume) and are kept as Q147, unchanged; flexor_carpi_radialis_r/palmaris_longus_r/flexor_carpi_ulnaris_r/anconeus_r/extensor_pollicis_longus_r have no Q147 seed at all (no Z-Anatomy source, or skin-containment failure) and are also unchanged. See data/derived/refine_report_zan2vhm_limb.json.
